_readme: Both Element parcels, 1500 and 1600 Royal Crest Drive: all 39 OSM building outlines and two pools. Apartment envelope is two storeys based on visible exterior rows; individual buildings outside the reference view remain uncertain. OSM height tags retained as evidence, not converted to guessed storey counts. Fine siding joints and rail pickets require detail >= 0.6.

sources.OSM: OpenStreetMap way 382484111, Overpass snapshot 2026-09-24; ODbL. Footprint preserved from the source.
sources.inference: Two visible residential storeys; 3.05 m floor spacing is estimated. Beige siding, white framed windows, open galleries and low dark roofs follow locally reviewed exterior references. Unseen faces and gallery placement are architectural inference; source images and identities remain local.
